# BetterSite

> Website redesign for small businesses. Get a free homepage preview within 48 hours, then choose a full rebuild for €490. English and French.

We rebuild your homepage on the stack that scored this page 100/100 on Lighthouse — engineered to convert visitors into customers.

## Machine-readable

- [Markdown mirror (EN)](https://bettersite.luongnv.com/index.md) — text/markdown rendition of the EN landing page
- [Markdown mirror (FR)](https://bettersite.luongnv.com/fr/index.md) — text/markdown rendition of the FR landing page
- [auth.md](https://bettersite.luongnv.com/auth.md) — agent authentication doc: none required, all BetterSite content is public
- [OAuth Protected Resource metadata](https://bettersite.luongnv.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource) — RFC 9728 JSON, delegates to the luongnv.com authorization server

## Agent tools

- [request_sample_hero](https://bettersite.luongnv.com/#request) — WebMCP declarative tool on the sample-request form: an agent can fill the website URL and email fields; the visitor confirms the submit
- [request_sample_final](https://bettersite.luongnv.com/#form-final) — same tool on the bottom-of-page form variant
